chunks: And whatever is in it from Mansur al-Sayqal, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn 'Abd al-Jabbar, from Abu Muhammad al-Dhuhali, from Ibrahim ibn Khalid al-'Attar, from Muhammad ibn Mansur al-Sayqal, from his father Mansur al-Sayqal.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; part of the author’s immediate transmission chain.
key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: The perfumer; a nisbah/title within the narrator chain.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal term indicating narration.
key_terms.مَنْصُورِ الصَّيْقَلِ: A named narrator whose transmission route is being identified.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Mansur al-Sayqal in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Mansur al-Sayqal in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance is bibliographical and hadith-related, documenting the author’s route of transmission through named narrators back to Mansur al-Sayqal.
